sources.title: Grok 4.5 native API documentation
sources.evidence: Exact grok-4.5 page and embedded model object document 500,000 context, TEXT/IMAGE inputs, TEXT output, functionCalling:true and reasoning:true. Current reasoning efforts are low, medium, high and xhigh, default high.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.5, July 8, 2026
sources.evidence: Original joint release says Grok 4.5 is a mixture-of-experts model trained with SpaceXAI, using Cursor data and reinforcement learning. It announces availability in Cursor on July 8. Direct canonical page fetched successfully.

sources.title: API release notes: July 8 and July 17, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated HTML places Grok 4.5 API availability under July 8. July 17 separately announces EU access. The original API entry lists low, medium and high reasoning efforts.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 model card, July 14; revised July 20, 2026
sources.evidence: Read the 29-page card, including development and safety sections. Pages 3–4 name both developers, identify SpaceXAI as XAI LLC doing business under that name, specify text/image inputs, hosted distribution, and supervised/reinforcement training. No numerical parameter or active-parameter counts appear. The complete original PDF was accessed through web retrieval and its cached PDF/text; direct shell fetch returned 403.

sources.title: Elon Musk: Grok 4.5 is the 1.5T model, July 18, 2026
sources.evidence: Original X JSON identifies Elon Musk and timestamp 2026-07-18T01:25:22.000Z. His post explicitly equates the existing 1.5T model with Grok 4.5, replying to a post about its parameter count. This is after public release. Canonical post https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2078289996323148076 returned 403 in direct web retrieval; original syndication JSON was successfully retrieved. The statement gives model scale, not active-per-token size.

sources.title: Elon Musk: Grok 4.5 private beta and V9 foundation, June 28, 2026
sources.evidence: Original JSON identifies Musk and timestamp 2026-06-28T10:50:05.000Z. The complete opening sentence maps Grok 4.5 to the 1.5T V9 foundation with supplemental Cursor training and describes a private beta at SpaceX and Tesla. Later long-post text is truncated, so only the intact opening statement is used. Canonical https://x.com/elonmusk/status/2071184354756477041.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.5, current dateline July 16, 2026
sources.evidence: Current announcement describes joint training with Cursor, technical work, reinforcement learning and API/Grok Build availability. Its later July 16 dateline is distinguished from the July 8 Cursor release and API changelog.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 model card, August 17, 2026 revision
sources.evidence: Read cached original 42-page PDF text, including introduction and development sections. Printed page 5 calls Grok 4.6 part of the 1.5T-scale family extending Grok 4.5. It does not report Grok 4.5 active parameters or an expert layout.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 model card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Read cached original 30-page PDF text and searched exact Grok 4.5 comparisons and development disclosures. No Grok 4.5 active-parameter count or expert configuration is given.

sources.title: Enterprise terms effective before Grok 4.5 launch
sources.evidence: The May 12 terms grant limited hosted API access and retain the underlying technology and intellectual property with xAI; they provide no model-weight redistribution license. Supports proprietary classification alongside the model card distribution section.

sources.title: Official xAI public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: Live official-organization API returned only grok-1 and grok-2. There is no Grok 4.5 checkpoint here; this is corroboration of the hosted distribution evidence rather than the sole basis for closed-weight classification.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 in Cursor
sources.evidence: The product documentation identifies the joint model and lists a 256k Cursor context. This is a product limit and does not replace the native xAI API specification of 500,000.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Kittens training kernel research, August 4, 2026
sources.evidence: Checked this later first-party MoE training research. Its test configurations concern named open-weight models, not a disclosed Grok 4.5 expert layout; kernel tuning parameters cannot supply Grok 4.5 model counts.

name.note: Exact public name and API identifier grok-4.5 match this record.

developer.note: Retain normalized xAI identity: the card explicitly treats SpaceXAI and xAI as interchangeable. Cursor is a joint training developer, acknowledged in the description and notes.

family.note: Grok family; no transfer of preceding Grok versions’ specifications.

release_date.note: Earliest verified public release is July 8 in Cursor and the xAI API. June 28 was private company beta, July 16 the current announcement dateline, and July 17 EU API access.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is through hosted products/APIs under retained proprietary rights; no public Grok 4.5 checkpoint is published in the checked official inventory. Open-source Grok Build harness code is not model weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access under enterprise terms, not an invented SPDX license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 1.5 trillion total model parameters, or 1,500 billion, from the founder’s exact Grok 4.5 statements before and after release. This is reported model scale, not a tensor inventory or active-per-token measurement.

active_parameters_b.note: The accessed original and later model cards, training disclosures and founder posts give no active-per-token count. MoE alone does not define a numerical active count; 1.5T is not reused here.

architecture.note: The co-developer’s original release explicitly identifies a mixture-of-experts model. No expert count, routing layout or narrower Transformer variant is established by the accessed sources.

context_window.note: Native xAI API model object and page specify 500,000 tokens. Cursor separately documents 256k within its product.

modalities.note: Exact native API modalities corroborated by the card. Agent-generated files or calls to external image tools do not add native output modalities.

reasoning.note: Explicit reasoning flag; configurable effort documented at release and currently. This boolean does not imply an exposed chain of thought.

tool_call.note: Native functionCalling flag is true, consistent with joint release tool-use training.

description.value: Grok reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and knowledge work, with text and image input and tool calling.
description.note: Neutral supported purpose and capabilities replace the unqualified lower-hallucination-risk claim.

patch.description: Grok reasoning model developed by xAI with Cursor for coding and knowledge work, with text and image input and tool calling.

sources.label: Original X record for parameter disclosure

patch.notes: Jointly trained by xAI (SpaceXAI) and Cursor. The 1,500B total is the founder’s nominal 1.5T model size, confirmed after release; active parameters and expert configuration remain undisclosed. Cursor identifies the architecture as MoE. Public API/Cursor release was July 8, 2026; June 28 was private beta and July 17 added EU API availability. Native API context is 500,000 tokens; Cursor documents a separate 256k product limit.

summary: Establishes nominal 1,500B total from original founder disclosures and MoE architecture from the co-developer release. Confirms July 8 public release and native API features, adds proprietary classification and joint-training attribution, and replaces a broad hallucination claim. Active parameters and expert layout remain undisclosed after later-card and training-research checks.
